listings.title: 2007 Acura Mdx SUV
listings.description:
Selling my 2007 Acura MDX. Yes, it has nearly a quarter of a million miles, but honestly, the way this vehicle drives and handles does not reflect the mileage. It has been my reliable get-to-work vehicle for the past couple of years and has served me well.
**Recent/upgraded items:**
* Newer Michelin tires installed approximately 2 years ago – roughly **2/3 tread remaining**
* Recently replaced both driver and passenger side headlight housings – the original housings had become yellowed and cracked
* Heated front and rear seats – all working
* Rear DVD entertainment system works as it should
* Sunroof operates properly
* Heat and A/C both work great
* Oil pan resealed less than 10k miles ago
* Oxygen Sensors replaced at 240k miles
* Transmission Fluid replaced at 242k miles
* Engine and Cabin Air Filters replaced less than 5k miles ago
* NGK OEM Spark Plugs replaced at 240k
* Driver side tailpipe and muffler replaced at 240k with aftermarket Walker brand
There are some cosmetic/interior imperfections consistent with the age and mileage. The leather on the steering wheel and driver's seat has cracked and split, which is a very common issue with Acuras and Honda's from this era. This is not being represented as a perfect or low-mileage vehicle—I'm just trying to be upfront about its condition. 2 advisory notifications appear when the car starts - one that says "Check DRL" since I replaced with LED and the load isn't registering with the computer. The other is for an airbag sensor issue, which I believe to be rooted in the passenger seat somewhere. All the airbags are intact and have never been deployed to my knowledge and Carfax records.
I really would like to keep it because it has been a good vehicle for me, but unfortunately the fuel economy isn't great for my daily commute. I've been averaging around 15 MPG running premium 91-octane fuel, and I need something more fuel-efficient as a daily driver.

listings.title: 2020 Ford Mustang GT Coupe
listings.description:
Rapid Red Metallic! 2 owners, I bought it certified preowned with 21,900 miles 4/2024, it has 37,400 miles now. There should be some transferable warrentee for power train. Always stored under cover in the winter. It is in fantastic shape and needs nothing. The maintenence is up to date which has been synthetic oil changes and a new battery 6 months ago. No disapointments.
- 10 speed auto with paddle shift
- Heated and cooled seats
- Heated Wheel
- Lane departure warning.
- Car cover included
- All programmable dash and LED colors
It has been a great summer car, I'm 62 and have not abused it in any way, never seen a track day. Insurance is not bad, and MPG is ~20 surprisingly good. Clean tiitle and no accidents.
Interior is perfect, back seats are unused because they are unusable for people over ~3 feet tall... under the hood is clean, trunk is amazingly big!
Only reason for sale is want to buy a C7 Corvette just to change things up a little, I love sports cars. This color Rapid Red + PP1 is kind of rare and definately has the look to set it apart, I have not seen another one around Mpls. 
The PP1 cars like this are the ones to get over a normal GT or GT premium: 
 - Performance Wheels & Tires: 19×9" front and 19×9.5" rear Ebony Black-painted aluminum wheels 
255/40R19 (front) and 275/40R19 (rear). Tires are in great shape, about 15K on them.
 - Braking Upgrades: Brembo™ six‑piston front brake calipers with large rotors 
 - Suspension & Chassis: Heavy‑duty front springs, K‑brace (steeda) for improved chassis rigidity, Strut‑tower brace.
 - Cooling: Larger radiator for improved heat dissipation 
 - Aero & Styling: Functional rear spoiler, Larger front lip and side skirts.
 - Interior & Instrumentation: Engine‑spun aluminum instrument panel.
 - Gauge pack: Vacuum and Oil Pressure gage upper center of dash.
 - Heavy duty sway bar
I did 2 modifications: These 2 "bolt ons" are a big improvement for the Coyote Engine that required no change to tune or engine modification and didn't affect warentee - Just help it breath in and flow out better, adding ~15 HP, taking it from 460 to ~475 hp. 
 - Corsa cold air intake. The OEM air box is included. This just flows and sounds better far better for intake. $435
 - Borla 60662 SwitchFire X-Pipe Exhaust Pipe. The OEM H pipe also does not flow smoothly. This thing sounds amazing and should for $600. The active exhaust is all retaind so you can program Quiet, Normal, Sport, Track. The cold start will let the neighbors know when you are going to work! Or you can program it or start quiet in the morning.

listings.title: 2014 Scion Xb Wagon
listings.description:
Selling my Toaster. 
Those that know Xb’s love them. Same here, this box is awesome.
 The Only reason I’m selling it is that I’m out of driveway space. 
The car is mostly OEM. I updated most of the lights to LED. 
I have stayed up to date on scheduled maintenance per the maintenance schedule book. 
Plugs replaced recently (per maintenance schedule)
Oil was changed approx 200 miles ago. Same with transmission fluid. It has been done every 80,000 miles. 
Currently on odo is just over 180,000. These Toyota cars easily get 250,000. There is a lot of life left in it. 
It has had 2 accidents. First was an inattentive driver entering the road and hit the car in the driver side rear wheel. Repair was new wheel and rear fender cover. 
The 2nd was this last winter when a deer was hit at 30mph. The repair was new front bumper cover, passenger fender, wheel-well liner some other plastic parts and I replaced both headlights at the same time since it was apart and easy. 
These box’s are simple to work on which makes them popular in the mod circles. 
Currently averaging 29-30 mpg. 
It pulls hard to 100mph. 
This is a great car, tons of interior space, is safe and maintained. 
Only way to appreciate it is to try it. 
Price is negotiable but I do have a low limit and I’m not desperate to unload the car. 
Until it sells, this is still a daily driver. Weekdays it will be in Green Lake; evenings and weekends it is in Omro. 
Call and text is best. If you call, leave a message and I’ll call back as fast as I can. 
Single owner and never left Wisconsin. 
910 (yes, fort Bragg area code- I won’t change it) 
551-388 four. 
Jon

listings.title: 1976 Triumph TR6 Convertible
listings.description:
Up for your purchase consideration is this very nice 1976 Triumph TR6. After a solid production run spanning from 1969 to 1976, The TR6 met its end road only to be replaced by the Wedgey looks of The TR7/TR8. For many, Triumph ended at The TR6. This was the last model that had body on frame and that Great Sounding Inline 6 cylinder powerplant in the engine room. With an athletic muscular look, The TR6 gained many an admirer over the years and continues to be quite popular today if one wants to experience the joys of Analog British Motoring! Here is your chance to get into a real nice driver quality TR6 and live that experience!
This TR6 has 72,550 miles on it. I am the third owner in its history with the first two, In Family, ownerships spanning a total of 49 years! Over those years, the TR6 received a variety of upkeep maintenance, replacement parts and even a paint job in the 1989-1990 timeframe. Over the years that followed, the TR6 has been maintained to be an acceptable driver quality condition that is clean and tidy but not perfect showing some little dings and scratches and touch ups over the years. Of course as with most advertisements the paint always looks nicer in the pictures and while it's not terrible it's aged a bit with a water spot here and there. Nothing that an all-out paint correction probably couldn't cure. If you are looking for a perfect concours example, then this would not be the one you seek. However, this example of a TR6 is more than presentable for cars and coffee duty and occasional show and where it really shines is just getting in it and driving the Joy from it!
This TR6 starts right up every time. With an initial manual choke adjustment to get things started, things warm up very quickly and settle into a very nice mellow Inline 6cyl tone. The focus on all the improvements and maintenance to this car were done to keep its reliability at a very high level, thus allowing you to enjoy it at any given moment. The following is a list of the improvements.
Drivetrain/Cooling/Electrical:
-Crane XR700 Electronic Ignition
-Distributor Refurbished and Set to "Advance" by British Vacuum Unit. 
-OEM style Stainless Steel dual pipe exhaust system from the manifold back (last few months) very nice system, Sound is Perfect; Sporty, NOT Loud!
-New Carb Choke Cable Assy.
-New Accelerator Pedal Assy Bushing and retainer kit. 
-Long throw clutch slave cylinder. (Uses DOT 5 synthetic fluid as DOES the Braking System!)
-New air filters and oil/filter change
-New oem style radiator, single groove water pump, 180 deg. thermostat, new red 13 blade fan assy. and fiberboard fan shroud kit.
-EGR deleted (have orig parts in a box) 
-New turn signal and flasher relays, reverse light switch, and ALL exterior bulbs/headlamps (Incandescent!)
-New oem HI and LO Horns
Brakes/Suspension/Chassis/Wheels, etc:
-clean driver quality underside. No Rust Through on the floors, rockers or frame. 
-New Brakes (front and rear); pads rotors, calipers, rubber lines, hardware (done in 2018-19)
-New Suspension Bushings, lever shock rebuilds, lowering springs (profile is nice, doesn't look/ride high like it's on stilts!)
-Factory Steel Rims Powdercoated
Interior/Comfort and Function upgrades:

listings.description:

This is a consignment so save $ on taxes and fees. Very reasonable miles for the year at just 92K. Clean history with no accidents! This is a rare and special vehicle for sure! Two blemished keep this vehicle from being a perfect 10-a scratch on the passenger side (not bad and hard to see) and a small tear in the driver window tint. Both are easily fixed and not expensive at all-I think the tint can be replaced for like $75. As a consignment vehicle you are buying from the seller directly and you will do tax, title and plates at the DMV. The listed price does not include any of those fees. We happily take trade-ins and we also buy vehicles outright. We can try to assist if you need financing and if you have your own lender we can get you what you need no problem. We NEVER buy our vehicles from these big auction houses where you have no idea what you are going to get! Proudly serving our community since 2014.
Here at Tazewell Motors we offer a nice variety of quality pre-owned vehicles under 15 grand and we specialize in putting great running vehicles on the road at great prices. We take great pride in what we do! We have a full repair shop and we work hard to make sure our vehicles are mechanically sound and ready for the road. We know our vehicles aren't brand new but just because our cars are priced low doesn't mean they are low quality. In fact, the opposite is true. Great cars at great prices-it's what we do. Most of our vehicles come with a FREE powertrain warranty because we stand behind our pre-owned inventory. We want to stand out from our competition.
We do things a little differently here. We NEVER buy our vehicles from these junky auction houses (like Morton, Clinton, Polen's, etc.) where dealers dump off cars they can't fix. You never know how any of these cars have been maintained either. It's just not a good way to buy-so we don't buy that way! The owner takes pride in personally buying every vehicle himself-and not from these auctions. We inspect all of our vehicles from top to bottom to make sure we are putting great vehicles on the road for our customers. We want our pre-owned vehicles to be better than the competition.
You can visit our website at www.TazewellMotors.com it has all of the vehicle info and prices. Check Google for hours.
The list price doesn't include tax, title and plates. Unlike most all dealers-we do NOT charge a doc fee or any other dealer fee at all!
We are located at 501 S. Main Street in Creve Coeur next to Thornton's.
Call us at 309-694-CARS (2277). OR EVEN BETTER-you can text the owner, David, directly at 309-229-4651.
We do offer limited financing and we have a few lenders depending upon your credit. Often times we encourage you to apply with your own bank and we can give you the necessary paperwork for that. WE ARE NOT A BUY HERE/PAY HERE DEALER.
Of course we accept trade-ins! We also buy vehicles outright and our offers are usually higher than other dealers.
We also our a consignment dealer which means we can sell your vehicles for you-sort of like a "realtor for your car"-we do the hard work of dealing with the public and handle all the marketing of your vehicle to save you time. It's a win-win! There is info about it on our website.
We have been proudly offering quality goods and services to our community since 2014.
Stop in and meet us and see our inventory and how we do things differently and BETTER for our customers!

listings.title: 1966 Ford Mustang GT Fastback
listings.description:
Own a piece of automotive history with this authentic 1966 Ford Mustang GT 2+2 Fastback. A true survivor vehicle, it features its original A-Code 289 CID 4BBL V8 engine paired with a classic 4-speed manual transmission. Carefully maintained within a private collection for over two decades, this vintage muscle car combines incredible originality with reliable performance.
The exterior is dressed in a factory-correct Turquoise Metallic paint finish applied over 20 years ago, highlighting excellent chrome accents, trim, and all-original glass. Inside, the cabin features the iconic original turquoise-and-white Pony Interior, complete with comfortable bucket seats, a full center console, a convenient fold-down rear seat, rally pack gauges, and a factory tachometer. All interior lights and the clock remain fully operational.
Further adding to its charm, this classic fastback includes a Cobra engine dress-up kit, an unmodified trunk and undercarriage, classic rally wheels, and a preserved 1979 Georgia State inspection sticker pointing to its rich Southern heritage. Freshly serviced with a new fuel tank, fresh fluids, a professional tune-up, new tires, and a replacement battery, this vintage Mustang GT Fastback is completely ready to drive, show, and enjoy. listings.title: 1965 Ford Mustang Coupe
listings.description:
1965 Ford Mustang Coupe — the original, and still the best year of them all. This is the car that started it all: a true American classic finished in deep burgundy with a clean black interior, powered by a 289 V8 with an automatic transmission and console shifter. From the wood-grain steering wheel and pony floor mats to the styled steel wheels with red center caps and all that bright chrome, every detail is pure first-generation Mustang — the long hood, the short deck, the lines nobody has ever improved on. Later years got bigger, but the ’65 is the one collectors want and the one everyone pictures when they hear the name Mustang. It turns heads everywhere it goes and sounds exactly like a classic V8 should.

Settle into the power driver seat, wrap your hands around the leather-wrapped tilt wheel, and keep tabs on the action with a full gauge lineup and tach. Comfort and convenience come standard for real-world driving too, with air conditioning, speed control, and handy storage in the center console (plus power points for your essentials). Little toucheslike illuminated visor mirrors, tinted glass, and fog lampsmake it feel ready for evenings out as much as sunny-day drives. And when the weather turns, the rear window defroster has your back.For peace of mind, a CARFAX report is available, and the car includes security help from SecuriLock along with modern safety essentials like front airbags and 3-point belts. If youve been waiting for a black Mustang convertible that blends V8 attitude with everyday comfort, this one is ready to make every trip feel like an event.

Subaru Introduces 2018 Forester Line with New Black Edition
New Black Edition combines distinctive style with substantial equipment upgrade
Subaru of America, Inc. introduced the 2018 Forester, highlighted by a distinctive new Black Edition that combines a comprehensive equipment upgrade with exclusive exterior and interior appointments. The Forester, Subaru's best-selling vehicle in the U.S., extends the model's 20-year tradition of delivering responsible engineering, sure-footedness and all-conditions performance, augmented in the current models with available turbocharged performance and compelling luxury.
All 2018 Forester models come standard with Subaru Symmetrical All-Wheel Drive, a distinction from competitive SUVs that come with front-wheel drive as standard and offer all-wheel drive as an extra-cost option. The Subaru Forester provides a refined, quiet ride thanks to comprehensive soundproofing measures, including an acoustic windshield.
Black Edition Dresses Up Forester
The Forester 2.5i Premium exclusively offers a new head-turning Black Edition package for 2018. The Black Edition equips this model with a significant equipment upgrade, including the Lineartronic CVT with a 6-speed manual mode and steering wheel paddle shift switches, a combination previously available only on turbocharged models. The Black Edition also comes standard with EyeSight Driver Assist Technology , X-Mode, Hill Descent Control and LED Steering Responsive Headlights.
The Forester 2.5i Premium Black Edition stands out with 18-in. black alloy wheels; fog lights with black accent trim; black finish exterior badges and mirrors; and a front grille with blacked-out wing motif and chrome frame.
The Black Edition likewise equips the Forester 2.5i Premium with a distinctive interior upgrade, including exclusive black cloth upholstery seats with simulated leather bolsters, complemented by a silver metallic and black gloss finish center dash panel. The leather-wrapped steering wheel and shift handle are highlighted with silver stitching, and the interior door handles feature a chrome finish. The All-Weather Package, rear cargo tray and Welcome Lighting all come standard with the Black Edition.

listings.title: 2011 Chevrolet Coupe
listings.description:
THIS... is a 2011 Chevrolet Camaro 2SS Coupe, finished in black with a black interior.
A partial list of notable equipment reported by the seller includes the RS Package, a dealer-installed Ground Effects Package, 21-inch wheels, Brembo brakes, and a Boston Acoustics sound system.
Notable modifications reported by the seller include a Roto-Fab air intake system, a Flowmaster axle-back exhaust system, and the front Chevrolet badge removed.
Chevrolet brought the Camaro nameplate back in 2010 after a long hiatus. First shown as a concept in 2006, the fifth-generation model wore a heritage-laced exterior design that borrowed styling cues from the original car but sported modern touches such as an independent rear suspension. It remained a pony car at heart — its main rival was the Ford Mustang, but it was also aimed at Japanese coupes like the Nissan 370Z.
Power comes from an L99 6.2-liter V8, rated at 400 horsepower and 410 lb-ft of torque. Output is sent to the rear wheels via a 6-speed automatic transmission.

What a machine. 4.7ltr twin turbo V8, all wheel drive, air suspension. I'm the 3rd Owner. No accidents or previous paint or bodywork. AutoCheck in hand. All service records in hand. I bought this with the intension of working on/enjoying it and then selling it. Everything works. There are no check engine (idiot lights) or error messages on the dash. All of the accessories work. Sunroof, rear and side window shades, heated/cooled and messaging seats, etc. The following, mechanically has all just been done:
Both front air shocks replaced 
Brand new rims, tires and TPMS sensors
Alignment
New c/v axel on the drivers side
New lower control arm/ball joint
New front brake pads
Synthetic Oil change
I have clay bared, polished and ceramic waxed the exterior. Cleaned and treated the interior. It looks great. There are no rips, tears or stains on the interior. Carpet and mats look great. There are a few small door dings and some light scratches on the exterior. No rust or anything significant. I have touched up what I could, and it looks great for its age. I have the owners manual, 2-keys and some extra parts. I'll also include a MB specific code reader/scanner to help diagnose/clear error messages and other items. Very handy. Free and clear title in hand and tabs are good thru 27. The only thing it may need at some point down the road are motor mounts. It has a slight vibration that occasionally happens at 1,500-2000 rpms. My price is back of KBB and it is firm. Please call, email or text with any questions.

 The freakin' 2013 Toyota Corolla.

Car could be fully restored or just finish up quater panel work and match factory patina for a survivor style hot rod. Doors , hood and trunk lid are in good shape no rust holes and door bottom edges look great. Perfect project car that has a good start on some of the hard work.

listings.description:
$13k firm. Check comps: thats a great deal. If no serious interest here, in January I'll sell it out West for >18k.
198k Miles.
Runs Excellent.
EGR deleted, but def & dpf still 'online' and work normally (does throw egr delete-related CEL codes: no impact on driveability at all).
Jake Brake works excellent.
OEM Trailer Brake Control.
Both Batteries Reliable.
Recent Work Done in May:
- Both Front Axle U-joints just replaced,
- All Front Brake Components: Calipers/Rotors/Pads/Rubber-lines.
- Entire Brake System Flushed, New Fluid.
- New Water Pump. Coolant System Flushed, All New Cummins-Rated Coolant.
- Fresh Oil/Filter Change + Air Filter.
- New CCV Filter.
- DPF Cleaned.
- Flatbed & Trailer Lights all work.
- All Grounds Inspected, Cleaned and Conditioned.
8x10' long Flatbed with a flush-mount gooseneck. This is designated a 'Cab and Chassis' truck and was originally a Fleet vehicle (with scheduled routine maintenance).
No TIPM issues at all (unlike my daily-driver '06 5.9!).
Interior in "Good" shape; driver's seat edge issues (typical). Passenger and back seat no rips.
Front tires @ 50%, Duallys @ 90%, all E-rated.
Includes like-new mounted spare.
Rust:
This is a northern truck and does have typical rust. The frame and all thick steel are absolutely solid and sound with only surface-patina rust. The Cab's sheet-metal only has issues on the road-facing surfaces; the red exterior paint is basically in very good shape.
The Flatbed's Frame & Structural steel is all solid and Sound. The peripheral tie-rails are all still sound and solidly welded at double-thick rail-points (pic). Sheet-metal rust but solid structural strength and usability.
The gooseneck's steel welds remain 100% safe & reliable.
I've provided detailed pics to honestly represent the degree of rust. I do not want to waste your time by misrepresenting any issues (nor my own).
Initially purchased to haul a backhoe but priorities changed and now I don't need a Dually (I own 2 other non-dually Rams).
Minnesota Title is in-hand and signed-over to me. When my plans changed I didn't bother to submit it for processing into my name, but I'd gladly accompany a buyer to a DMV to insure a problem-free transfer.
Price:
The truck is currently located in Hurley, Wisconsin, at the U.P. border. If a Buyer is willing to come here to buy the truck I'd knock $500 off the $13k.
Otherwise, I plan to wait until there's enough serious interest to justify Westbound delivery.
Thanks for your interest.

listings.title: 2001 Dodge Ram 2500 Truck
listings.description:
2001 Ram 2500 Laramie SLT Quad Cab, 8 ft bed, in two-tone Dark Garnet Red Pearl and silver. 5.9L 24-valve Cummins turbo diesel, automatic, 2WD. Polished wheels, fog lights, power driver's seat. Odometer shows 59,250 miles.
My wife's parents owned it before us, up to about 50,000 miles, and sometimes pulled their fifth wheel with it. We bought it from them and have put on only the miles since. We no longer have a use for it. A 2019 oil change sticker still on the window shows the next service due at 53,000 miles. Laird Noller Topeka dealer badge still on the tailgate.
Recent work and upgrades:
- New Firestone Transforce CV2 245 R16 load range E tires (2026 date code), mounted Oct 2026, front aligned and balanced
- Synthetic oil and filter change, Oct 2026
- FASS DRP02 lift pump
- New BHAF air filter and Filterwears pre-filter, original air box included
- Boss Elite BE9ACP touchscreen stereo with Apple CarPlay, Android Auto, and Bluetooth. Backup camera included but not installed.
- Pendaliner bed liner included, cut out for the fifth-wheel rails. Removed for the bare-bed photo so you can see the floor underneath.
- No body rust other than where the blowout tore the metal
Rear receiver hitch. Trailer brake controller is installed; I haven't used it with a trailer. Fifth-wheel rails are installed in the bed. Reese fifth-wheel hitch (part 30047, rated 16,000 lb trailer / 4,000 lb pin) available with the truck for $300. Some surface rust on the head.
Being upfront about the flaws:
- Passenger side lower panels are crushed and torn around the rear wheel from a tire blowout, with scuffs and some surface rust on the exposed metal
- Passenger running board is damaged near the wheel
- Surface rust on the frame, axles, and suspension (see photos). Would be a good candidate for a wool wax coating.
- Oily residue on the underside of the engine
- Air conditioning doesn't work
- Scratches and scrapes throughout; bed floor paint is worn
- Speedometer reads 3-5 mph high after going from 265/75 to 245/75 tires. Can be recalibrated; I haven't had it done.
No accidents that I know of other than the blowout damage above. No lien on the title. Free NICB VINCheck shows no theft or total loss record. Pre-purchase inspection welcome at your expense.
Sold as is. Serious local buyers only. Payment by cash or cashier's check, completed at a bank (yours or mine) so it can be verified. No shipping, escrow, or verification codes.
